Reference image for the [[Anagrams]] row on [[Niado Duegad]], whose title is an anagram of "Dianoga Dude": the [[Dianoga|dianoga]] raising its eyestalk out of the garbage water in the Death Star trash compactor in ''Star Wars'' (1977), later titled ''Star Wars: A New Hope''.

Source: a frame at 1:09 of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lELsG66HPYM Luke, Leia, Han & Chewie Get Stuck in the Garbage Compactor | Star Wars: A New Hope | Official Clip], Star Wars (official Lucasfilm channel), YouTube (24 July 2026), from the 3840 by 2160 stream. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260920200911/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lELsG66HPYM Internet Archive], 20 September 2026. Cropped to the creature, which leaves out the channel's caption, and reduced to 950 by 800 pixels. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: 6ee91cc563fa763c3b8510d565089a5313911821faa1b81865eca0b70b930fa3.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single cropped, reduced-size frame from an official promotional clip for ''Star Wars'', © Lucasfilm Ltd., used only to show the creature the card title refers to, beside the card on [[Anagrams]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the film or harm its market, and no free image of the dianoga exists.
